unit_note: USD millions. Table 5 uses dots for no transactions and (**) for amounts below $500,000 in absolute value. Both marks are omitted from the numeric cells. This scope includes the Administration for Children and Families and the smaller agency lines that feed the companion departmental total. FDA prints gross -94, applicable receipts 1 and outlays -94 in both October columns.
